purpose: Shared SFX index for all flows (avatar_reel etc.). Search HERE before downloading a new SFX. Entries point to the HeyGen sound catalog by id; the .mp3 files are NOT shipped — re-fetch and process them with `sfx_lib.py add` (needs the HeyGen CLI). design_systems are neutral tags you can rename for your own visual systems.
source_catalog: heygen audio sounds list --type sound_effects --query '<desc>' (HeyGen CLI >= v0.1.1)

signature_processing.note: Every new SFX is processed with a consistent signature chain before entering the library: resample 48k, highpass, subtle pitch per class, peak-normalize to -3 dBFS, anti-click fades (5ms in / 40ms out), mp3 192k. This is what makes the set feel cohesive. Tune to taste.
signature_processing.pitched_v1: asetrate 48000*0.94 + atempo 1.06383 (≈ -1 semitono, house timbre for whoosh/glass/ui/pop/sparkle) + highpass 80Hz
signature_processing.impact_v1: asetrate 48000*0.92 + atempo 1.08696 (≈ -1.4 semitonos, más peso) + highpass 35Hz
